summary: Reserve one pending send worker per idempotency key

replay.detail: Successful heal replay backoff begins after actual replay completion instead of before writer waiting. The reservation, graph/health publication and original backoff interval remain. A refused rebuild can still wait on snapshot digest work; one admitted rebuild is unbounded.

schema.detail: Unchanged by the same-key worker admission correction.

compatibility.detail: An already-held message.send key waits asynchronously within the shared confirmation deadline before allocating another pending worker. Healthy identical retries receive the original durable receipt; an expired wait returns the existing unconfirmed outcome. Completed receipt and changed-payload conflict handling remain. No new response shape or generated contract.
